checks.explanation: Consumer discretionary spending did show signs of softening through 2024, with several major retailers and consumer brands cutting prices or lowering earnings guidance amid weakening demand.

The S&P 500 rose substantially from January 2024 through the 18-24 month window (mid-2025 to early 2026), consistent with a continued market melt-up driven partly by strong AI-related capital inflows.
Equity markets did continue a strong melt-up through 2024 and into 2025-2026, with major indices reaching new highs well above January 2024 levels.
No comparable magnitude of pandemic-era stimulus (2020-2021 style direct fiscal and monetary money-printing) has recurred since, consistent with this prediction.
This is a roughly 20-year prediction (through approximately 2044) that cannot be meaningfully assessed only two years into the window.
Legacy media companies continued to experience significant layoffs and financial distress through 2024-2026, including major cuts at outlets like CNN, Washington Post, and various newspaper chains.

Texas's razor-wire border dispute with the federal government saw courts largely rule against Texas on federal preemption grounds in various rulings, while Governor Abbott retained strong public support in Texas and among many conservatives nationally on the border security issue.
